The Doors at the Hard Rock Cafe in LA's Skid Row. 1969

That would be the Hard Rock Cafe (no relation to the famous HRC) at 300 East 5th Street in Los Angeles. It is on the back cover of The Morrison Hotel album as well as the inner gatefold.

On December 17, 1969, after The Doors took what would become the “Morrison Hotel” album cover photos, Jim Morrrison wanted to get a drink. It was late in the afternoon so they decided to drive down to Skid Row where all the bars were. As they drove though downtown Los Angeles looking for a spot to go in, they spotted the Hard Rock Café. The Doors went in for some drinks, took some photos inside and outside and used them for the back cover of The Morrison Hotel album as well as the inner gatefold
